degradations.detail: gnomon records a gate refusal (exit 126) as an ordinary bash result, not as a refusal: its outcome bucket and task exit code do not reflect the gate.
Only bash passes through the gate. write/edit/webfetch/task/MCP calls are governed by gnomon's own write_allow, approval and surface guards, not by cacogate.
ask_human, sandbox and canary verdicts refuse (exit 126): the wrapper cannot reach gnomon's Approver.

gnomon passes no session id to child processes; the wrapper uses gnomon-<pid of nearest non-shell ancestor>, or $CACOGATE_SESSION when set. Harness version and model are recorded only when CACOGATE_HARNESS_VERSION / CACOGATE_MODEL are exported.
The model must prefix commands itself (system.md). An unprefixed command is refused by bash_allow, which fails closed but costs a turn.
